title: The Empire Strikes Back
wiki_lead:
The Empire Strikes Back (also known as Star Wars: Episode V – The Empire Strikes Back) is a 1980 American epic space opera film directed by Irvin Kershner from a screenplay by Leigh Brackett and Lawrence Kasdan, based on a story by George Lucas. The sequel to Star Wars (1977), it is the second film in the Star Wars film series and the fifth chronological chapter of the "Skywalker Saga". Set three years after the events of Star Wars, the film recounts the battle between the malevolent Galactic Empire, led by the Emperor, and the Rebel Alliance, led by Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia. As the Empire goes on the offensive, Luke trains to master the Force so he can confront the Emperor's powerful disciple, Darth Vader. The ensemble cast includes Mark Hamill, Harrison Ford, Carrie Fisher, Billy Dee Williams, Anthony Daniels, David Prowse, Kenny Baker, Peter Mayhew, and Frank Oz.
Following the success of Star Wars, Lucas hired Brackett to write the sequel. After she died in 1978, he outlined the entire Star Wars saga and wrote the next draft himself, before hiring Raiders of the Lost Ark (1981) writer Kasdan to enhance his work. To avoid the stress he faced directing Star Wars, Lucas handed the responsibility to Kershner and focused on expanding his special effects company Industrial Light & Magic instead. Filmed from March to September 1979 in Finse, Norway, and at Elstree Studios in England, The Empire Strikes Back faced production difficulties, including actor injuries, illnesses, fires, and problems securing additional financing as costs rose. Initially budgeted at $8 million, costs had risen to $30.5 million by the project's conclusion.
Released by Twentieth Century-Fox on May 21, 1980, the highly anticipated sequel became the highest-grossing film that year, earning approximately $401.5 million worldwide. Unlike its lighthearted predecessor, The Empire Strikes Back met with mixed reviews from critics, and fans were conflicted about its darker and more mature themes. The film was nominated for various awards and won two Academy Awards, two Grammy Awards, and a BAFTA, among others. Subsequent releases have raised the film's worldwide gross to $549–$550 million and, adjusted for inflation, it is the 13th-highest-grossing film in the United States and Canada.
Since its release, The Empire Strikes Back has been critically reassessed and is now often regarded as the best film in the Star Wars series and among the greatest films ever made. It has had a significant influence on filmmaking and popular culture and is often considered an example of a sequel superior to its predecessor. The climax, in which Darth Vader reveals he is Luke's father, is often ranked as one of the greatest plot twists in cinema. The film spawned a variety of merchandise and adaptations, including video games and a radio play. The United States Library of Congress selected it for preservation in the National Film Registry in 2010. Return of the Jedi (1983) followed The Empire Strikes Back, concluding the original Star Wars trilogy. Prequel and sequel trilogies have since been released.

grok_lead: Star Wars: Episode V â The Empire Strikes Back is a 1980 American epic space opera film directed by Irvin Kershner and produced by Gary Kurtz for Lucasfilm Ltd.. It serves as the second installment in the original Star Wars trilogy, following Star Wars (1977) and preceding Return of the Jedi (1983).. The screenplay was written by Leigh Brackett and Lawrence Kasdan, based on a story by George Lucas.. The film features a principal cast including Mark Hamill as Luke Skywalker, Harrison Ford as Han Solo, Carrie Fisher as Princess Leia Organa, Billy Dee Williams as Lando Calrissian, Anthony Daniels as C-3PO, David Prowse as Darth Vader, James Earl Jones as the voice of Darth Vader, Frank Oz as Yoda, and Kenny Baker as R2-D2.. Set three years after the destruction of the Death Star, the story follows the Rebel Alliance as they evade the Galactic Empire's forces, with Luke undertaking Jedi training under the exiled master Yoda on the swamp planet Dagobah while Han, Leia, and their companions face pursuit by Darth Vader.. The film's production began in 1979, with principal photography taking place in Norway's Finse region for the ice planet Hoth scenes, England's Yoda's Hut set at Elstree Studios, among other locations.. Despite challenges including harsh weather and a tight schedule, Kershner's direction emphasized darker tones and character development compared to the first film, at Lucas's encouragement.. The score was composed by John Williams, whose work earned an Academy Award nomination.. Visual effects were handled by Industrial Light & Magic, contributing to the film's Special Achievement Academy Award for Visual Effects.. Released theatrically by 20th Century Fox on May 21, 1980, following premieres in Washington, D.C., and London, The Empire Strikes Back opened to widespread acclaim.. It grossed $4.9 million in its opening weekend and ultimately earned $292.8 million domestically and $257.3 million internationally, for a worldwide total of $550 million against an $18 million budget.. The film received a 93% approval rating from critics on Rotten Tomatoes (as of November 2025), based on 173 reviews, with the consensus praising its emotional depth and defiance of expectations.. It won one Academy Award for Best Sound, along with a BAFTA Award and a Grammy, and has since been voted the greatest film of all time in a 2014 poll by Empire magazine.. The Empire Strikes Back is renowned for its narrative twists, innovative special effects, and expansion of the Star Wars universe, influencing subsequent science fiction cinema and solidifying the franchise's cultural impact..
